purpose: Local, public-safe research demonstration corpus. PDFs are intentionally excluded from Git; obtain them only from the recorded publisher URLs.

documents.title: Artificial Intelligence Playbook for the UK Government
documents.publisher: Government Digital Service / Department for Science, Innovation and Technology
documents.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated
documents.redistribution: Do not commit the source PDF. Attribute Crown copyright and check any material marked otherwise stated before separate reuse.
documents.third_party_review: Licence notice is on final page; manual visual review is required before reusing any individual figure or third-party branded image. Demo shows metadata and page citations, not source-page images.

documents.title: International Scientific Report on the Safety of Advanced AI: Interim Report
documents.publisher: UK AI Safety Institute / Cabinet Office / Department for Science, Innovation and Technology
documents.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated
documents.redistribution: Do not commit the source PDF. Attribution is required; third-party material is excluded unless separately cleared.
documents.third_party_review: The PDF licence page expressly flags third-party copyright. No figure/image is redistributed by this demo; source page and publisher URL remain the verification path.

documents.title: Strategic competition in the age of AI: emerging risks and opportunities from military use of artificial intelligence
documents.publisher: UK Ministry of Defence / RAND Europe
documents.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated (confirm in exact PDF before public redistribution)
documents.redistribution: Local evaluation only until individual third-party rights are reviewed. Do not place the PDF in a repository.
documents.third_party_review: Commissioned RAND Europe material may contain credited third-party figures. The application exposes only metadata/page citations and the manifest records this restriction.

documents.title: World Development Report 2024: The Middle-Income Trap
documents.redistribution: PDF is not committed. Any redistribution/adaptation must retain the World Bank attribution and licence notice; do not imply World Bank endorsement.
documents.third_party_review: The report's rights page governs the work; separately credited figures, maps, and third-party material require individual review before reuse. The demo does not redistribute page images.

documents.title: Public Health England Annual Report and Accounts 2019/20
documents.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated
documents.redistribution: Do not commit the source PDF. Attribute Crown copyright; separately licensed material is excluded.
documents.third_party_review: The rights page identifies a Guzelian photo on pages 8 and 86. It is not used in screenshots or exports; the original PDF is retained only locally.

rejected_downloads.reason: Publisher-hosted overview was only 30 pages, below the full-length corpus threshold. It is never indexed.
